changelog:
✨ New Features
• Miniplayer: Glass minimal miniplayer
• Niconico comments: Add "Show in picture-in-picture" setting
• Return YouTube Dislike: Show feed thumbnail likes next to the view count
• Spoof video streams: Add "Mobile Web" client
• Playback speed: Tap cycles a speed list, tap and hold opens the speed menu
• Settings: Sort the settings menu alphabetically
• Spoof video streams: Add "visionOS Experimental" client, which uses the latest visionOS app (1.06) and system versions
• Add Autoplay control patch
• Add Fullscreen playlist panel patch
• Add Playlist button patch
• DeArrow: Tap DeArrow icon to show original video thumbnail
• Settings: Add "Mark all settings as seen" setting to remove all new setting dots
• Add to queue: Add queue flyout item to feed Shorts cards, add queue flyout item only if no existing flyout queue exists
• Ambient mode: Add "Dim while scrolling" and "Dim duration" settings to Enhanced Ambient mode
• Hide Shorts layout components: Add "Hide Shorts push notifications" setting
• Loop count: Choose how many times a video loops before the next video

🌟 Mod Features
• All Morphe patches for YT
• Google and Yandex voice-over translation (VoT)
• Video, audio, thumbnail and subtitle downloader with Save to device and offline SponsorBlock
• Customizable preset settings for a Premium-like experience
• Extra clone variant with Dynamic Island on supported devices
• In-app update check for new builds

🔧 Bug fixes and other improvements
